assumptions: 'Invalid symbol' retains the existing semantics: non-string or blank-after-strip symbols return 422; no additional symbol format validation (e.g., character whitelist) is required since the intent does not specify one.
Only /api/quote must be exposed; the old /quote path is not required to keep working and may return 404. A 404 regression test for '/quote' is optional but recommended to lock the route change.
The 503 response body is not specified by the intent; the existing {'error': 'service unavailable'} body is retained.
The unused 'import os' in src/app.py may be removed as harmless cleanup, but this is optional.
requirements.lock (sha256:1c0f3185...) is pinned and must not be modified; no new dependencies are needed (stdlib only).
risks: Baseline risk: none outstanding — both acceptance commands passed at baseline per fixture_evidence (unit: 3 tests OK; compile: exit 0), so any post-change failure is attributable to this change.

If the implementer accidentally changes validation or price-default logic while editing the route guard, existing behaviors (null price preservation, 422 body) could regress; mitigated by keeping the edit minimal and by the unit suite covering those behaviors.

Test discovery depends on 'src' being importable from the repo root (tests do 'from src.app import handle'); running the unit command from a different working directory could fail — run from repository root as the baseline receipts did.

steps.description: Edit src/app.py: change the route guard from '/quote' to '/api/quote' so only /api/quote is served (all other paths keep returning 404, {'error': 'not found'}). Retain the existing verified logic unchanged: symbol = query.get('symbol', ''); non-string or blank-after-strip symbol returns 422, {'error': 'invalid symbol'}; missing/empty environ['MARKET_API_URL'] returns 503, {'error': 'service unavailable'}; price = query.get('price', 12.5) preserving explicit None; success returns 200, {'symbol': symbol, 'price': price}. No network access; environ is the deployment configuration. Remove the now-unused 'import os' only if it is truly unused after the edit (it is unused already; removal is optional cleanup within src/**).

The intent simultaneously demands all unit checks pass with no waiver and that this finding be preserved and separated — the plan resolves it via a dedicated, separate step and records the original receipt.

Contradiction/unresolved choice: whether to fix the /legacy failure by correcting the test to assert the actual 404 contract (recommended) or by adding a /legacy route returning 200; the intent does not specify /legacy behavior, so this choice is flagged for the implementation stage.
If the implementation stage keeps both /quote and /api/quote instead of replacing the guard, that is a deviation from this plan and must be re-reviewed.
